text:
sam k: Quick sync — onboarding nova-13b-int3 on staging shows a ~7% drop on our control validation rerank score vs prod. Looks like two suspects: tokenizer mapping differences + noisy near-duplicates in the control set after tokenization. Can we triage and get a quick smoke pass? @li zhang @anya :eyes:
li zhang: On it. I'll run a fingerprint dedupe pass with tokenwalk-v2 and compare overlap. Running now, ETA ~25m. Command I'm using: ```bash
python infra/tools/dedupe.py --input s3://redwood/promptbank/controlset --out /tmp/control-dedupe --tokenizer nova-tokenizer-v2 --min-sim 0.95
```
anya: I'll diff the tokenizer maps between master and nova-13b-int3. I already see NFKC normalization differences for some unicode punctuation — could cause token-length shifts. Will push a quick mapping patch if needed.
matt_g: I can spin a tiny dedicated pool to run int3 smoke evals on the post-dedupe control set. Spinning 2xA100 on staging now, should be ready in ~15m. :rocket:
labelops-bot: relabel job queued by matt_g — job_id=9876, sample_count=2000, priority=high, est_completion=6h.
sam k: Great. Post-dedupe + tokenizer patch, let's do a rerun and compare per-sample diffs. If the same 100 samples still diverge, we'll hand those to labelops for targeted relabel + human review.
li zhang: Dedupe finished. We removed ~3.1% of controlset examples (mostly short, almost-identical prompts). Pushed dedup results to s3://redwood/promptbank/controlset-dedup/1769001234. Quick stats: total_in=65,032 -> out=62,997.
anya: Found 42 mapping mismatches that change token boundaries (mostly em-dash / en-dash vs double hyphen). Wrote a compat layer that normalizes to NFKC + dash-normalization. Patch: ```diff
--- tokenizer/v2/map.json
+++ tokenizer/nova-13b-int3/compat-map.json
@@ -142,6 +142,9 @@
  "–": "-",
  "—": "-",
+  "\u00A0": " ",
+  "\u200B": "",
+  "\u2019": "'",
```
Testing locally now.
matt_g: Smoke evals started on deduped set + tokenizer compat. Running both float32 baseline and int3 quant pipeline. Command: ```bash
./run_eval --model nova-13b-int3 --inputs s3://redwood/promptbank/controlset-dedup/1769001234 --out /tmp/eval-nova-int3 --batch 8 --kv-cache True
```
deploy-bot: test-deploy(nova-13b-int3-smoke) started by matt_g at 2026-03-23T14:12:00Z.
li zhang: Quick note — dedupe removed several short conversational seeds that were actually purposeful variants (e.g., punctuation-only variations). I flagged ~120 examples as keepers and reintroduced them to a 'short-variants' set for manual review. Path: s3://redwood/promptbank/controlset-shortvariants/1769001234.
anaya: compat layer applied to tokenizer in staging and re-tokenized the controlset. Token-length distribution post-patch matches prod tokenizer within 0.4% mean absolute diff.
sam k: Awesome. If smoke evals look good, we'll schedule a constrained canary on Dedicated for 4h window. If regressions persist, we'll escalate to ML review with per-sample diffs. Also want to trigger a rerun of our rerank eval harness with 10 random seeds.
labelops-bot: relabel job 9876 updated: 2000 samples in progress, assigned to pool "fast-review", expected completion 6h.
matt_g: Smoke eval results: int3 vs float32 diff summary: mean_rerank_delta = -0.9%, median = -0.3%, 98th percentile drop = -6.8%. Most big deltas are concentrated on ~95 samples. Uploading per-sample diffs to /tmp/eval-nova-int3/diffs.json.gz
li zhang: I'm pulling the top-95 diff samples and running a fast exact-match duplication check plus tokenizer side-by-side to identify where tokenization changed semantics. Will post a short CSV.
anya: For the 95 samples, 34 show token-boundary shifts, 21 are paraphrase edge cases (should be relabeled), the rest look like actual model behavioral delta.
sam k: Plan: 1) labelops finish relabel job -> we reconcile 21 paraphrase edge cases, 2) ops to re-run int3 with modified quant kernel (tune activation clipping) on the 34 token-shift samples, 3) ML to review remaining ~40 model-deltas. @matt_g @li zhang please coordinate.
matt_g: Ack. I'll rerun a focused quant kernel tweak on the 34 token-shift samples with activation_clip=0.02 and report differences.
li zhang: I'll coordinate with labelops to prioritize the 21 paraphrase samples for human rerate. Adding a small note to the relabel job.
labelops-bot: relabel job 9876 note added: prioritize sample_ids -> csv attached.
sam k: Thanks all — this thread is enough to track next hour actions. Ping here when relabel done or if kernel tweak changes larger set. :thumbsup:
